name: kb_balance_druid
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's balance list: keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm on the mob, cast Starfire under Arcane Eclipse and Wrath under Nature Eclipse, fish with Starfire when neither is up, Hurricane at four mobs, and Innervate itself when the mana runs low. The set-piece upkeep and the leveler's Starfire-first opener stay with the preset's own strategies.

rows.text: Opener: pre-cast Starfire on kill target; if Nature Eclipse -> Wrath; else Insect Swarm (fresh tank: first) -> Moonfire |
Moonfire | missing on current target (BoAT Starfire crit needs it on that target)
Insect Swarm | missing on current target (Wrath mana refund)
Starfire | Arcane Eclipse active; if remaining Eclipse < Starfire cast, reapply Moonfire instead

entries.note: The KB also reapplies Moonfire when less Eclipse remains than one Starfire cast; a condition cannot time an aura, so Moonfire's own entry refreshes it once it is gone.

rows.text: Wrath | Nature Eclipse active; refresh Insect Swarm only in its last GCD

entries.note: Insect Swarm is refreshed by its own entry once it is missing; the KB's last-GCD refresh needs the debuff's remaining time, which is not a condition.

rows.text: alternate Starfire/Wrath (cast the spell that can proc the Eclipse not on cooldown) | no Eclipse active

entries.note: The engine has no alternation state: with no Eclipse up Starfire (the KB's own pre-cast fisher) goes first, and Wrath follows when Starfire is not in the book.
The second half of the KB's alternation; it plays when Starfire cannot (a low level).

rows.text: let an in-progress cast finish | Eclipse procs mid-cast of opposing spell

entries.note: Moved ahead of the fillers (the KB lists them last): a filler with no condition would take every tick, so the execute and the moving cast would never play.
Same move; the fillers also wait for the player to stand still.

rows.unexpressed: how long a mob lives is not in the conditions

rows.text: DoT targets that will live the DoT duration; Eclipse spells on them
rows.unexpressed: how long a mob lives is not in the conditions

rows.text: pre-cast Starfire (fish Nature Eclipse) then Hurricane

entries.note: The KB's pre-cast Starfire before the Hurricane is the starfire_fish entry. Band high and first of the AoE rows: a filler with no condition would otherwise take the tick at four mobs.

rows.text: none (structural gap) | no burst cooldown; use trinkets on the first crit of a window [[d:druid#1369235779762655325]]
Innervate | self when mana is low; T3 2-piece strengthens it on others [[d:druid#1455354717159948338]]

entries.note: The KB gives no number for 'low mana': 40% is the healer engine's mana-save threshold. The preset's druid_innervate strategy keeps its own rule as well.

rows.text: Hurricane | interrupted channels still trigger the 10 s cooldown [[d:druid#1482975539810533446]]
